title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
“这么多！”他连忙从储物球里面再次拿出一枚辣番果和一条茄子。先是咬了一口辣番果，然后又扒开茄子的表皮，看着里面饱满的籽粒和白嫩的肉，便能一步断定，这应该是一种不输于辣番果品质的蔬菜！“品质应该还行吧？”林枫有些不确定的问道。虽然对自己种的东西很是自信，但第一次卖，林枫也不清楚外面的市场怎么样。“这何止是还行？这已经能称得上秘宝级别的蔬菜了，长期吃的话，能让人类身体素质上升的好东西！”陈萧忙回道。听到这样的回答，林枫期待的搓了搓手，“那陈叔你看？”“收，全部收，这辣番果，按照e级秘宝的价格跟你收，一斤五十块！其它的也都差不多！”开什么玩笑。这种买回去，对宝可梦和人类都有益处的果蔬，只要他好好的控价，宣传一波，根本不愁客户。而且，物以稀为贵。像这种蔬果，不是任何种植园都能种出来的。据他所知，整个梧桐市，除却了花桥村那个养殖大奶罐的牧场，能挤出鲜甜的d级哞哞鲜奶外。其它的种植园，根本不可能种出达到评级的果蔬。也就是说，如果旺旺超市想要垄断这种果蔬，就只能从林枫这里来进货！想到这里。陈萧连忙道：“小枫呀，这蔬果的品质很好，但叔叔更想跟你做一步生意，那就是能不能买下这里的独家代理权？”“这？”林枫表情上有些为难了起来。“放心，叔出钱，出卖出去的股份都行，只要你肯开口。”见到林枫犹豫，陈萧立马就急了起来，也不能怪他一下子失去了理智。实在是最近被旺旺超市打压的有些喘不过气来，现在正好看到了翻盘的希望，容不得他不激动。旁边的黄音缈知道自己的身份，她在丈夫商谈工作的事情上面，从来不会插嘴。但看着丈夫焦急的模样，也不由得将求助的目光看向了林枫。林枫有些尴尬的道：“咳咳...不是这个问题，我在想，如果以后种植出来的东西，陈叔收不下，那我也不能卖给其它地方吗？所以，这点我只能保证，第一时间考虑的是陈叔...”“好好好，这样也行。”听到林枫这么说，陈萧悬着的心终于掉了下来。林枫继续道：“就是...陈叔，我还有一个小小的要求。”陈萧的心又提了上来，“你说。”“那就是在卖我家果蔬的时候，我想贴上一个logo，标注是邻家培育屋卖的。”

林枫将自己的想法提了出去。秦爷爷说的没错。自己应该要有长远的目光，致力于将邻家培育屋发扬光大！这样，才会有更多的训练家和宝可梦知道这里。然后给林枫提供源源不断的系统奖励！“呼...我还以为啥事呢...这是小事情，到时候，你将logo标志发过来，我直接给你打印贴上去。”陈萧拍着胸膛，直接将这件事情全部包揽。两人又互换了绿泡泡，交付了尾款。在黄姨的一声“常来玩。”后，驾着面包车向着梧桐市飞速驶去。“5万...”看着账户上到账的信息，林枫深呼吸了一口气，接着露出了兴奋的表情，这些年，因为入不敷出，父母留下的钱，是用一点少一点，所以林枫的生活也算节俭。可现在，仅仅只是一次收购，就让他直接挣了5万！他原本还以为最多只能挣个几千块钱呢。没想到，竟然能卖出这么多。要知道，这只是种植园产出的第一批农作物，接下来过几天就会有第二批，第三批....如此，发家致富，就在眼下呀！兴奋之余，他直接抱起了藤藤蛇，激动的喊道，“哈哈哈，藤藤蛇，我们有钱了！”他现在是恨不得一口亲在藤藤蛇的脸上，可惜被两根藤鞭抵住了下巴。换来的只有藤藤蛇一脸“嫌弃”加疑惑的表情。训练家的样子，好像有点不对劲？......回家的路上，被藤藤蛇的鞭子堵住嘴巴的林枫稍稍冷静了下来。尽管知道自己作为神级培育家，以后应该不会缺钱。但以后是以后，现在是现在。他前几天还是一个会为了是否购买洛托姆都犹豫不决的男人呢。“藤藤？”藤藤蛇走在他身边，有些小心的看着林枫，它刚刚实在是忍不住才动手的。而且，力气肯定是非常小的。“没事，藤藤蛇，我只是太过于高兴了。”林枫挥了挥手，表示自己没事。
content_en:
"So many!" He quickly took out another spicy tomato and an eggplant from the storage ball.First, I took a bite of the spicy tomato, and then peeled off the eggplant's skin. Looking at the plump seeds and white tender meat inside, I was able to conclude that this should be a vegetable that is not inferior to the quality of the spicy tomato!"The quality should be good, right?" Lin Feng asked with some uncertainty.Although he was very confident in what he grew, it was his first time selling and he didn't know what the market outside was like."Is this more than just okay? This can already be called a secret treasure-level vegetable. If eaten for a long time, it will be a good thing that can improve human physical fitness!" Chen Xiao hurriedly replied.Hearing such an answer, Lin Feng rubbed his hands in anticipation, "What do you think, Uncle Chen?" "Take it, take it all. This spicy fruit will be charged to you at the price of an E-level secret treasure, fifty yuan per pound! The others are about the same!" What a joke.Buying this kind of fruits and vegetables, which are beneficial to Pokémon and humans, as long as he controls the price and promotes them well, he won't have to worry about customers at all.Moreover, things are rare and valuable.Fruits and vegetables like this cannot be grown in any plantation.As far as he knew, in the entire Wutong City, except for the ranch in Huaqiao Village that raised large milk tanks, it could squeeze out fresh and sweet D-grade moo milk.It is simply impossible for other plantations to grow fruits and vegetables that meet the rating.In other words, if Want Want Supermarket wants to monopolize this kind of fruits and vegetables, it can only purchase them from Lin Feng!Think of this.Chen Xiao quickly said: "Xiao Feng, the quality of these fruits and vegetables is very good, but my uncle would like to do further business with you, that is, can you buy the exclusive agency rights here?" "This?" Lin Feng looked a little embarrassed."Don't worry, I can pay for it or sell the shares, as long as you are willing to speak." Seeing Lin Feng's hesitation, Chen Xiao immediately became anxious, and you can't blame him for losing his mind all of a sudden.He was really out of breath after being suppressed by Want Want Supermarket recently, and now that he saw the hope of a comeback, he couldn't tolerate being less excited.Huang Yinmiao next to her knew her identity. She never interfered in her husband's discussions about work.But seeing her husband's anxious look, she couldn't help but look at Lin Feng for help.Lin Feng said with some embarrassment: "Ahem... That's not the problem. I was thinking, if Uncle Chen can't harvest what I grow in the future, can't I sell it to other places? So, I can only guarantee that the first thing I will consider is Uncle Chen..." "Okay, okay, that's okay." Hearing what Lin Feng said, Chen Xiao's heart finally fell.Lin Feng continued: "That's it...Uncle Chen, I have a small request." Chen Xiao's heart was raised again, "Say." "That is, when selling my fruits and vegetables, I want to put a logo on it, indicating that it is sold by the neighboring cultivation house."

Lin Feng put forward his thoughts.Grandpa Qin is right.You should have a long-term vision and be committed to promoting the neighborhood nursery!In this way, more trainers and Pokémon will know about this place.Then provide Lin Feng with a steady stream of system rewards!"Huh...what did I think it was...this is a small matter. When the time comes, you can send me the logo and I will print it and paste it up for you." Chen Xiao patted his chest and took over the entire matter.The two exchanged green bubbles again and paid the balance.After Aunt Huang said, "Come here to play often.", she drove the van towards Wutong City at high speed."50,000..." Lin Feng took a deep breath while looking at the credit information on his account, and then showed an excited expression. Over the years, because he could not make ends meet, his parents had to use less money, so Lin Feng's life was considered frugal.But now, just one acquisition made him directly earn 50,000 yuan!He originally thought he could only earn a few thousand yuan at most.Unexpectedly, so many were sold.You know, this is only the first batch of crops produced by the plantation. In the next few days, there will be a second batch, a third batch... In this way, you can make a fortune right now!In his excitement, he directly hugged the Vine Snake and shouted excitedly, "Hahaha, Vine Snake, we are rich!" He now wanted to kiss the Vine Snake on the face, but unfortunately, two vine whips pressed against his chin.All he got in exchange was a look of "disgust" and confusion on Teng Teng Snake's face.There seems to be something wrong with the trainer's appearance?...On the way home, Lin Feng, whose mouth was gagged by the Vine Snake's whip, calmed down a little.Although I know that as a god-level cultivator, I will not be short of money in the future.But later is later and now is now.A few days ago, he was a man who was hesitant about whether to buy Rotom."Vine?" The Vine Snake walked beside him and looked at Lin Feng cautiously. It just couldn't help but did it.Moreover, the strength must be very small."It's okay, Teng Teng Snake, I'm just too happy." Lin Feng waved his hand to express that he was okay.
